about: Who may have a pull-request run signed with the CI key. Read from the BASE commit of the pull request, so a pull request cannot widen it. 'logins' are GitHub accounts: the account that opened the pull request, the account that first triggered the run and the account that re-ran it must all be listed (GitHub authenticates these). 'emails' are exact commit author and committer addresses (git author fields are free text, so they only catch a stray commit by someone else; Co-authored-by trailers are not read); 'noreply_logins' accept [ID+]LOGIN@users.noreply.github.com for those logins; 'committers_also' are extra committer-only addresses (GitHub's own web-edit committer). No globs. Forks are refused before this list is read.
